title: 🚽 Disaster Sanitation Workshop
description: Join neighbors to learn how to prepare for any disaster that breaks our plumbing! All are welcome. Best practices for alternative bathrooms (twin bucket system and hands-free handwashing) and other disease prevention strategies. Organized by Foster/Powell NET; open to all!

title: Neighborhood Pod Starter Kit
description: Our NET training covers disaster response — this workshop covers the community organizing skills to build strong neighborhood ties before disaster hits. Practice the 1:1 conversations and first-meeting basics that turn interested neighbors into a community preparedness pod, and leave with a starter kit of tools, a plan for your first outreach, and a group to check in with along the way.

title: Fall City-wide Deployment Exercise (CDE)
description: Twice a year, NET teams all over the city role-play a disaster scenario and practice search and rescue, triage, radio communications, and Incident Command Structure. Lots of fun, and a great way to practice the skills you learned in basic training. If you're still waiting for a spot in Basic NET Training, you can participate as a Spontaneous Unaffiliated Volunteer (SUV). Registration opens in October.
